Re: Appeal of prior authorization denial  
Member: Skyler Iverson  
Member ID: W313340363  
Plan: Alaska Medicaid  
Reference number: POC-30230D15F4-69823  
Requested procedure: C5-C6 anterior cervical discectomy and fusion  
CPT: 22551  
Requesting physician: Okafor, MD

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for the requested C5-C6 anterior cervical discectomy and fusion, CPT 22551. The denial states that the submitted imaging findings do not support medical necessity.

The imaging and clinical records support the requested procedure:

- The MRI dated June 28, 2026, shows a C5-C6 disc herniation with severe right foraminal narrowing and compression of the C6 nerve root.
- I have right-sided radicular pain and numbness extending into the right thumb and index finger, consistent with the affected cervical nerve root.
- I have weakness and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the C5-C6 imaging findings.
- Provocative testing is positive on the affected side.
- Symptoms have progressively continued for 12 months and include neck pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- I completed 20 supervised physical-therapy visits over eight weeks, from May 6, 2026, through July 1, 2026. Treatment included cervical traction and postural training, without adequate resolution of the symptoms.
- I used NSAIDs for four months with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 6, 2026, provided only three weeks of partial relief.
- The symptoms remain functionally significant because of persistent radicular pain, numbness, and weakness.

The MRI therefore does not represent an incidental or nonspecific finding. It identifies a specific structural lesion at C5-C6, severe right foraminal narrowing, and C6 nerve-root compression that correspond to my symptoms, examination findings, and neurologic deficit. The records also document a substantial trial of conservative treatment without adequate or durable improvement.

The clinical record does not identify active infection, untreated substance use, or other stated contraindication. I have a BMI of 29 and am a nonsmoker.

I request that the denial be overturned and that authorization be issued for the requested C5-C6 ACDF, CPT 22551. In the alternative, please conduct a physician-to-physician review with Okafor, MD, and provide the complete clinical criteria and specific imaging findings that the reviewer believes are absent.

I have not quoted the plan’s medical policy because the specific policy text applied to this request was not publicly retrievable. Please provide a copy of the exact Alaska Medicaid cervical-spine-surgery criteria, including the version or revision date and all imaging and medical-necessity requirements used in reviewing reference number POC-30230D15F4-69823.

Please consider the enclosed records:

1. MRI cervical spine report dated June 28, 2026  
2. Physical therapy discharge note documenting 20 visits from May 6, 2026, through July 1, 2026  
3. Medication and treatment history  
4. Corticosteroid injection record dated May 6, 2026  
5. Examination findings documenting weakness, sensory symptoms, positive provocative testing, and the corresponding neurologic deficit  
6. Operative recommendation and clinical assessment from Okafor, MD

Please confirm receipt of this appeal and provide the appeal determination in writing.

Sincerely,

Skyler Iverson
